chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the attribute of *al-Basir* (The All-Seeing), emphasizing that Divine perception is not merely observational but inherently appreciative of wisdom (*hikmah*) and goodness (*khayr*). This concept reinforces the Shia theological stance that God’s sight is pure and free from defect, serving as a basis for believers to cultivate a positive, wisdom-oriented perspective of the world. It also subtly addresses theodicy by framing all creation through the lens of divine intent rather than mere existence.
